name: New Balance
verdict: Owned by New Balance Athletics, Inc. (Jim Davis and family, estimated 95%). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Proposed tier none for issue #434 (2026-09-28). Privately held; Jim Davis and his family own an estimated 95% (Forbes). No state owner.
